name: Hotel Terme di Saturnia
positioning: Thermal spa and golf resort, officially Terme di Saturnia Resort, built around a natural hot spring in 120 hectares of unspoilt nature, in hospitality since 1919
best_for: Travelers who want to soak in a natural hot spring with thermal pools included in the stay
Golfers who want a championship 18-hole course on site

facts.text: The resort is set amid 120 hectares of unspoilt nature.
The resort has been in hospitality since 1919.
The resort includes a spa, a GEO-certified 18-hole golf course and two restaurants.
The hot spring was well known by the Romans.
Stays include unlimited access to the Natural Hot Spring, thermal pools, whirlpools, hydromassage jets and kneipp course.
The Roman Bath, with sauna and Turkish bath, is for the exclusive use of resort guests.
La Stellata is a Tuscan farmhouse trattoria overlooking the hills, serving traditional Tuscan and Maremma dishes.
1919 Restaurant is a pied dans l'eau restaurant.
The golf Club House is within the hotel hall.
Terme di Saturnia has its own team of physician specialists and a blood and genetic analysis center.
An exclusive pet-friendly area is set up on the lawn of the Spring.
The concierge can arrange wine tastings, guided village tours and tours by e-bike, horseback or hot-air balloon.

highlights.text: After a 40-year journey underground, the hot spring water emerges at 37.5 degrees Celsius.
A hot spring at the centre of the resort feeds the natural pool and all the thermal pools, whirlpools and vascular paths.
A typical Tuscan countryside Casale was restored into an air-conditioned space for relaxation, including a Hay Room scented with yellow hay.
The golf course is a championship par 72, 18-hole course designed to merge with the surrounding hills.
The private spa suite in Room 306 has a Jacuzzi, tatami and sensory shower.

considerations.text: The resort is in the countryside: Rome Fiumicino airport is 150 km from Saturnia, and the concierge can book transfers to and from airports or train stations.
The large thermal pool area is a separate day spa facility that resort guests also have access to, and two of its four thermal pools are reserved for children.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a car for exploring nearby attractions.
